lesson_intro.heading: Cloud Engineer · PM-3.3
lesson_intro.board_text:
Application Load Balancer
Finova · finova-dev · ap-south-1

Why before how:
Users hit a stable entry — not one fragile instance IP.

Mental model:
ALB distributes to healthy targets across AZs.

You will: watch → learn → practice one navigation.
lesson_intro.ren_voice: I am Ren. Users hit a stable entry — not one fragile instance IP. Mental model: ALB distributes to healthy targets across AZs. I demonstrate, then you practice. Least privilege and Region discipline stay non-negotiable.

whiteboard_intro.board_text:
Application Load Balancer
• ALB distributes to healthy targets across AZs.
• Mistake: Single instance with Elastic IP as 'the website'.
• Habit: Health checks must match real app readiness.
whiteboard_intro.ren_voice: Board picture: ALB distributes to healthy targets across AZs.. Juniors usually: Single instance with Elastic IP as 'the website'.. Your habit: Health checks must match real app readiness..

segments.title: Open EC2
segments.setup_voice: Watch — we open EC2 the way a real ticket starts.

steps.voice: Navigate to EC2. Confirm Region ap-south-1 before you trust the empty list.
Load balancing belongs with compute design — one entry, many healthy workers.

segments.lesson_voice: If targets are unhealthy, ALB will not save a bad deploy.

check.voice: Why use an ALB instead of one instance IP?
check.response_if_correct: Stable entry and distribute only to healthy targets.

steps.voice: Finova marketing site on one instance — AZ blip took payments help pages down.
Trap: Single instance with Elastic IP as 'the website'.. Habit: Health checks must match real app readiness.

check.voice: What habit will you keep from this lesson?
